sensory_details_i_remember: I remember the faint smell of antiseptic wafting through the air, mixed with the sweet aroma of nervous sweat
I noticed the soft hum of fluorescent lights above, flickering in sync with the anxious murmurs of my peers
I felt the cool, smooth surface of the clinic's bench beneath my fingers as I paced back and forth, resume clutched tightly in my hand
I recall the muffled sounds of silent group chats, the occasional burst of excited whispers when someone received a placement update
